subject: Prospect capacity contingency and quote harmonization
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: hw-sales@greystone-oem.com, cloudops@stratuscloud.com, procurement@bigretail.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity ramp for BigRetail (requirements + ask)

Hi all,

Following our call this morning—BigRetail (BR-2026-Q4-017) has signaled intent to commit to a Dedicated pool but needs production capacity aligned to a holiday rollout window. High level ask:

- Initial steady-state: 80 x A100-equivalent GPUs for inference (128-token median seq).
- Peak burst (first 8 weeks): +40 GPUs to support onboarding traffic spikes.
- Desired live date for first tranche: 2027-01-15; full steady-state by 2027-02-15.

We need two parallel confirmations: a) OEM lead times & firm ship dates for new servers (quote requested), and b) cloud partner availability for a bridge/reserved burst if OEM fulfillment slips.

Please reply with:
- Greystone: firm ETA ranges and any partial-shipment options; include any rental partner suggestions if standard lead times exceed 8 weeks.
- StratusCloud: short-term reserved burst/spot pool pricing and region (us-west-2) availability for Jan-Feb 2027.

Attachments: I attached the preliminary workload profile we discussed.

Thanks,
Ben
—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: hw-sales@greystone-oem.com <hw-sales@greystone-oem.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bigretail.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:27:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ramp for BigRetail (requirements + ask)

Ben / Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks for the details. Greystone can supply standard 4U inference nodes configured with dual A100-class GPUs. High-level notes:

- Current lead time to ship: 10–12 weeks from PO for full new-builds.
- Partial shipment option: we can prioritize an initial 24-node build (48 GPUs) and ship in 6–7 weeks with expedited manufacturing (expedite surcharge applies).
- Rental partners: we have a short-term hardware rental program with "EdgeLease" (regional pools) that can deliver racks within 2–3 weeks; rental pricing is typically ~1.8x monthly equivalent of CAPEX amortized over 6 months.

I attached a draft quote (greystone-quote-v1.pdf) that shows list pricing, lead times, and expedite options.

If Redwood needs firm commitment on expedite slots we can hold a 10% deposit to secure a build window.

Regards,
Luis Martednez
Enterprise Sales, Greystone OEM
hw-sales@greystone-oem.com
Attachment: greystone-quote-v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: hw-sales@greystone-oem.com, cloudops@stratuscloud.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ramp for BigRetail (requirements + ask)

Luis / Stratus team — thanks for the quick response, Luis. A few clarifying items from Redwood's engineering and commercial side:

1) Splits and fallback: We need a deterministic plan if Greystone cannot deliver the full 120 GPU commitment by 2027-02-15. Proposal:
   - Ship 48 GPUs (expedite) by 2027-01-15 (to hit initial launch).
   - Use StratusCloud reserved burst (if available) to cover remaining peak + onboarding until Greystone final shipments complete.

2) Partial shipments & compatibility: Are the expedited nodes identical in HW profile (same model/firmware) so we can treat them as part of the same Dedicated pool? Firmware and NIC config must match or we need a validated image for the first tranche.

3) Cost levers: We will evaluate expedite deposit vs. premium on rental bridge. If EdgeLease rental is materially cheaper than Stratus burst, we may prefer that for short-term. Please share rental contact + T&Cs.

Action items:
- Greystone: confirm firmware parity & whether expedite tranche can be provisioned with identical image and KV-cache compatibility. Confirm earliest ship date for expedited 48 GPUs (firm ETA and cutoff to secure expedite slot).
- StratusCloud: confirm burst capacity on us-west-2 for Jan 15–Feb 15, pricing for 40 GPUs (24/7) and any minimum commitment or setup lead time.

cc: Vivek — we may want a commercial fallback (credit or SLA concession) if OEM misses committed dates.

Thanks,
Soojin
—
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: cloudops@stratuscloud.com <cloudops@stratuscloud.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bigretail.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ramp for BigRetail (requirements + ask)

Soojin / Ben / Marissa,

We ran the capacity check for us-west-2. Short summary:

- We can offer a Reserved Burst pool of up to 56 A100-class GPUs between 2027-01-10 and 2027-03-01, subject to a 45-day booking notice.
- Pricing: $/GPU-hour is included in the attached sheet (stratus-bridge-offer.xlsx). For a continuous 40 GPU 24/7 reservation, the estimated monthly cost is $XXX,XXX (we provided a 30-day pro forma).
- Network configuration: we can pre-stage VPC peering + routing rules in 7 business days once purchase order and contact IPs are provided.

Notes: rental vs cloud burst comparison — EdgeLease rental pricing will be competitive for very short windows (2–8 weeks) but involves on-site rack install and decommissioning logistics; Stratus gives a software-first onboarding experience.

If you want to lock the burst, we'll need a PO or a signed MSA addendum by 2026-12-15 to guarantee the 2027-01-10 start.

Best,
Diane Park
Partnerships Ops, StratusCloud
Attachment: stratus-bridge-offer.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, hw-sales@greystone-oem.com, cloudops@stratuscloud.com, procurement@bigretail.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ramp for BigRetail (requirements + ask)

All — quick internal alignment and next steps.

Summary of choices:
- Greystone can expedite a 48-GPU tranche in ~6–7 weeks (needs 10% deposit to hold slot).
- Stratus will hold up to 56 GPUs for Jan 10 start if we sign PO/MSA addendum by Dec 15.
- EdgeLease rental is an option but requires on-site coordination and may push setup by 3–4 days.

Recommended path (for commercial and delivery risk reasons):
1) Secure Stratus reserved burst for 40 GPUs for Jan 10–Feb 15 (sign PO/addendum) to guarantee the launch window. HubSpot Deal BR-2026-Q4-017 will absorb the cost as a time-limited ramp credit. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BR-2026-Q4-017
2) Put 10% deposit on Greystone expedited tranche for 48 GPUs to get the first physical capacity into our Dedicated pool (target ship by 2027-01-20).
3) Negotiate a delivery credit (pro-rated) with Greystone if final shipments miss Feb 15 steady-state.

Marissa / Vivek — can you review the proposed commercial (cost vs. expedite deposit) and sign off by EOD Monday 2026-12-07? If we proceed, I will start the PO draft and pull in legal for the MSA addendum.

Ben
—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment references: DocuSign pre-sign link (https://www.docusign.net/BR-017/quote-sign)
